title: Cartwise Rewards Earning Rate Card
content:
Points per dollar, the tier multiplier and the balance ceiling for new earnings are the three figures of Cartwise Rewards earning that are set tier by tier.

## Rates by tier

| Tier | Points per whole dollar of qualifying spend | Tier multiplier on base points | Balance ceiling for new earnings, in points |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cartwise Rewards Member | 1 | 1.0 | 50000 |
| Cartwise Rewards Bronze | 1 | 1.1 | 50000 |
| Cartwise Rewards Silver | 1 | 1.25 | 100000 |
| Cartwise Rewards Gold | 1 | 1.5 | 100000 |
| Cartwise Rewards Platinum | 1 | 1.75 | 200000 |
| Cartwise Rewards Diamond | 1 | 2.0 | 250000 |

The balance figure is the level above which new earnings are cut to the room left.

## Terms common to every tier

The following terms are the same at all six tiers, Member through Diamond:

| Term | Setting at every tier |
|---|---|
| When points for an order post | When the order closes |
| What counts as qualifying spend | The order's item subtotal after item refunds |
| Rounding of fractional points | Rounded down (floor): any fraction of a point is dropped |
| Fees count as qualifying spend | No |
| Tips count as qualifying spend | No |
| Alcohol lines count as qualifying spend | No |
| Cartwise+ membership fees earn points | No |
| The part of an order paid by gift card counts as qualifying spend | Yes |

## Points of judgement

- A delivery fee, a service fee or a tip on an order adds nothing to the qualifying spend at any tier.
- An item line of alcohol adds nothing to the qualifying spend at any tier.
- A Cartwise+ period fee earns no points at any tier.
- An item subtotal paid wholly or partly with a Cartwise gift card is qualifying spend in full: the gift-card-paid part counts like any other payment.
- Points per whole dollar is 1 at every tier; the tiers differ in the multiplier and in the balance figure.

## Hypothetical illustration

Suppose (hypothetical inputs) a closed order has an item subtotal after item refunds of $80.40, of which $12.00 is alcohol, plus a $5.99 delivery fee and a $6.00 tip, and $30.00 of it was paid with a gift card. Its qualifying spend is the $80.40 item subtotal less the $12.00 of alcohol, that is $68.40; the delivery fee and the tip are left out, and the gift-card-paid part stays in.
